provenance.nonce_crosslinks: Every observed value resolves to an existing .harness/changes/.execution/<value>.json

cases: different field at canonical execution path
non-v4 token at canonical phase path
extra field on same token line
same token at product config path
wrong snapshot digest at exact snapshot path

limits: Only generic-api-key is scoped out for UUIDv4 token lines in known public workflow artifacts or the exact skill_application_verified event schema. A UUIDv4 credential misfiled into one of these exact nonce fields cannot be distinguished by syntax alone. Other keys, shapes, paths and provider rules remain detectable.
